samples.title: Telco churn — contract assumptions
samples.description: Explore contract tier and churn; inspect how the result depends on the graph and measurement timing.
warnings: The preset graph is a hypothesis, not a discovered or validated graph.
Snapshot tenure may be post-treatment. Timing can invalidate the proposed adjustment.
Contract category coding assumes equally spaced tiers; inspect encoding before interpreting a coefficient.
This snapshot is not a randomised intervention and cannot establish a business recommendation.

samples.title: Health spending — specification sensitivity
samples.description: Start with the 2019 country snapshot, then compare the levels model with a deliberately reviewed log transformation.
warnings: This demo starts in original units. Log transforms are not applied silently.
Child mortality is recorded per 100 live births; verify units before reporting effects.
Region is nominal. The current generic preprocessor may use ordinal codes; inspect alternative encoding.
Country aggregates are observational and do not establish patient-level or policy effects.
